title.narrative: UNICEF, partnering with the Ministry of Education;made significant progress to equip adolescents with 21st century skills .;88,000 students, (secondary to upper-secondary), benefited from socioemotional education and remedial learning to address learning loss. Strategic alliances and multi-year resource mobilization efforts;strengthened STEM education.UNICEF and the MoE are driving systemic change through the continuity of national learning recovery programs, supporting implementation of the new national curriculum through digital platforms and teacher training,;impacting the educational content delivered by teachers;regarding socioemotional learning.
